name: Apache DataFusion
tagline: Extensible Rust query engine library on Apache Arrow for building databases and data systems.
description: Apache DataFusion is an embeddable SQL and DataFrame query engine written in Rust on Apache Arrow's columnar memory format. Rather than a finished database, it is a toolkit: a parser, cost-aware optimizer and multi-threaded vectorized executor with extension points for custom tables, functions, optimizer rules and execution plans. Systems such as InfluxDB 3 are built on it, and the Comet subproject accelerates Spark. DataFusion is the right choice when you are building a data product; end users looking for a ready-made database are better served by DuckDB or ClickHouse.

scale.notes: Single-process multi-threaded; distributed execution via the Ballista subproject or the host system.

strengths: Highly extensible: custom sources, UDFs, optimizer rules and plans
Fast vectorized execution on Arrow with good ClickBench results
Safe, embeddable Rust with no runtime dependencies
Reads Parquet, CSV, JSON, Avro and integrates with Iceberg/Delta crates
Large ecosystem of systems built on it (InfluxDB 3, Comet, many startups)
weaknesses: A library, not a database: no storage, server or users out of the box
Requires Rust expertise to build on
Frequent major versions with breaking API changes
useCases: Building custom databases and query engines
Query layer for time-series or log stores
notIdealFor: End users wanting a ready-made database
